values: 召唤大量的飞剑对敌人造成伤害。
Summons flying swords to deal damage to the enemy.
召唤大量的飞剑持续对一名敌人进行攻击，造成9次30% ATK伤害，每次附带敌人当前生命值5% + 0.5%的额外伤害，额外伤害最高不超过自身150% + 10%的攻击力。优先选择当前生命值最高的敌人作为目标。

Salazer summons plenty of Flying Swords to launch 9 strikes to an enemy with the highest HP. Each strike deals 30% ATK damage plus damage equal to 5% + 0.5% of the target's current HP. Additional damage cannot exceed 150% + 10% of Salazer's ATK. Salazer prioritizes the enemy with the most HP.
本技能造成的伤害还会附带50点生命汲取。
The damage dealt by this skill grants Salazer 50 Life Drain.
伤害提升至32% ATK，每次附带敌人当前生命值5.5% + 0.5%的额外伤害。
The damage of each strike is increased to 32% ATK plus damage equal to 5.5% + 0.5% of the target's current HP.
伤害提升至34% ATK，每次附带敌人当前生命值6% + 0.5%的额外伤害。
The damage of each strike is increased to 34% ATK plus damage equal to 6% + 0.5% of the target's current HP.
伤害提升至36% ATK，每次附带敌人当前生命值6.5% + 0.5%的额外伤害。
The damage of each strike is increased to 36% ATK plus damage equal to 6.5% + 0.5% of the target's current HP.
对扇形范围的敌人造成伤害，命中后若敌人生命百分比较低则额外追加一次伤害。
Salazer whips enemies within the radius of an arc, dealing extra damage once if the enemy's HP ratio is low after being hit.
鞭打面前2格扇形范围的敌人，造成180% + 15% ATK伤害，若命中后敌人生命值百分比低于70%，则会立即追加一次鞭打，对面前2格扇形范围的敌人额外造成230% + 25% ATK伤害。

Salazer whips enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing 180% + 15% ATK damage. When the target's HP ratio drops below 70%, Salazer launches one more attack to enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing 230% + 25% ATK damage.
伤害提升至185% + 15% ATK，追加鞭打的伤害提升至235% + 25% ATK。
Increases the damage to 185% + 15% ATK and the damage of the additional whip attack to 235% + 25% ATK.
伤害提升至190% + 15% ATK，追加鞭打的伤害提升至240% + 25% ATK。
Increases the damage to 190% + 15% ATK and the damage of the additional whip attack to 240% + 25% ATK.
伤害提升至200% + 15% ATK，追加鞭打的伤害提升至250% + 25% ATK。
Increases the damage to 200% + 15% ATK and the damage of the additional whip attack to 250% + 25% ATK.
对一名生命百分比较低的敌人造成大量伤害并使其无法行动。
Salazer deals massive damage to an enemy with a low HP ratio, making them unable to move or act.
使用飞剑将一名生命值百分比低于70%的敌人囚禁，造成300% ATK伤害并使其被强制倒地无法行动，持续5 + 1.5秒。本技能对每名敌人最多触发一次。
Salazer imprisons an enemy whose HP ratio is less than 70%, dealing 300% ATK damage and making them unable to move or act for 5 + 1.5s. The skill can only be applied to each enemy once.
每次成功囚禁一名敌人时，自身将永久吸收其8%的攻击力，每场战斗中自身通过这个方式吸收的攻击力最高不超过自身50%的攻击力。
Every time Salazer imprisons an enemy, he absorbs 8% of the enemy's ATK until the battle ends. This skill can absorb up to 50% of Salazer's ATK in each battle.
每次成功囚禁一名敌人时，自身将永久吸收其10%的攻击力，每场战斗中自身通过这个方式吸收的攻击力最高不超过自身50%的攻击力。
Every time Salazer imprisons an enemy, he absorbs 10% of the enemy's ATK until the battle ends. This skill can absorb up to 50% of Salazer's ATK in each battle.
每次成功囚禁一名敌人时，自身将永久吸收其12%的攻击力，每场战斗中自身通过这个方式吸收的攻击力最高不超过自身50%的攻击力。
Every time Salazer imprisons an enemy, he absorbs 12% of the enemy's ATK until the battle ends. This skill can absorb up to 50% of Salazer's ATK in each battle.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低12%。
Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低16%。
Reduces damage taken by 16% during battle.
战斗中，自身的受到的伤害降低20%。
Reduces damage taken by 20% during battle.
战斗开始、囚禁敌人后，“快意鞭打”没有冷却时间，并且必定会追加一次鞭打。
The Enraptured Whip has no cooldown after a battle starts or an enemy is imprisoned. A guaranteed whip attempt will be added.
战斗开始以及每次成功囚禁一名敌人时，自身沐浴灵魂的力量，释放下1次“快意鞭打”不会进入冷却时间，并且必定会追加一次鞭打。
Salazer immerses himself in the power of the Spirits and casts Enraptured Whip 1 times without cooldown when a battle starts or an enemy is imprisoned. An extra whip strike will be attempted.
“快意鞭打”附带敌人当前生命值5%的额外伤害，额外伤害最高不超过自身150%的攻击力，并且“快意鞭打”造成的伤害还会附带50点生命汲取。
The Enraptured Whip deals additional damage equal to 5% of the enemy's current HP, granting 50 Life Drain to Salazer. The additional damage cannot exceed 150% of Salazer's ATK.
释放下2次“快意鞭打”不会进入冷却时间。
Casts Enraptured Whip 2 times without cooldown.
“快意鞭打”附带敌人当前生命值5.5%的额外伤害，额外伤害最高不超过自身160%的攻击力，并且“快意鞭打”造成的伤害还会附带52点生命汲取。
The Enraptured Whip deals additional damage equal to 5.5% of the enemy's current HP, granting 52 Life Drain to Salazer. The additional damage cannot exceed 160% of Salazer's ATK.
囚禁敌人后，自身回复生命值。
Salazer heals himself after imprisoning an enemy.
每次成功囚禁一名敌人时，自身回复150% ATK生命值。
Salazer recovers 150% ATK HP for every imprisoned enemy.
“缚身囚魂”伤害提升60%，每当一名曾被囚禁的敌人被击败后，斯莱泽享受这名敌人的灵魂，获得抵御值等同于该敌人100%最大生命值的护盾，抵御值最多不超过自身1500%的攻击力，持续15秒。

Salazer increases the damage of Spirit Shackles by 60%. Each time an enemy that he has previously imprisoned is defeated, grants him a shield equal to 100% of that enemy's max HP. The shield lasts for 15s, and its value cannot exceed 1500% of Salazer's ATK.
